parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity and no documented border, facility or care targeting of visitors, but national protection is absent and patchwork protections vary by locality. Documented exclusions with little consequence, societal killings without a derivable rate, a 2020 Pride arrest, and birth-sex male custody with abuse/survival practices if detained create elevated conditional severity. Positive responses, harassment statutes and local ordinances mitigate partly. Overall elevated risk, above routine-detention regimes and below working-protection regimes.

entry_documents.exposure: Not documented. No visitor document rejection, X-marker refusal or border questioning documented; absence of domestic gender recognition is resident-facing and not deducted per rubric.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented. No documented visitor document-acceptance rule.
entry_documents.interaction: Visitor uses home passport; domestic birth-certificate bar does not itself reach entry, but could matter if detained or later checked.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented: transgender women housed in ordinary male dormitories, mandatory head-shaving, safety via inmate hierarchies/informal protection arrangements; one southern annex groups LGBT detainees to prevent abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Partial: one jail annex segregation to prevent abuse, but no national placement rule and practice varies.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: If a visitor were detained for any reason, birth-sex custody exposure follows irrespective of local anti-discrimination ordinances. No documented pre-emption.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No national facility rule documented. Two local ordinances textually ban male feminine attire/cross-dressing, one under imprisonment, but enforcement not documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Nine provinces and 32+ municipalities prohibit SOGI discrimination; women's/safe-spaces statutes punish transphobic slurs/ridicule.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Local protections and restrictive ordinances coexist by locality; traveller experience depends on destination, with no documented national override.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors. No HRT import, ward-placement or care-refusal evidence for trans visitors.
care_services.protection: City right-to-care card for registered LGBTQ couples in government hospitals is resident-focused, not a documented visitor guarantee.
care_services.interaction: Hospital ward placement if emergency care needed is an unanswered question, not a documented exposure.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No criminalisation of trans identity/same-sex conduct. Grave-scandal provision covers public sexual conduct/display, not documented as applied to presentation. 2020 Pride arrests under assembly/communicable-disease statutes.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Harassment penalties in social-worker, women's and safe-spaces statutes; school uniform policy permits identity-matching uniforms.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Public assembly/protest carries documented arrest risk; mere presence/presentation has no documented criminal charge path.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented for travelling minors with guardians; no visitor age-specific entry, care or facility rule documented.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented for visitors. Resident school policies are climate signals only.
minors_guardians.interaction: No documented interaction for a minor traveller beyond general custody/facility unknowns if detention or hospitalisation occurred.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented exclusions from establishments with little consequence; scattered killings/assaults including two June 2025 killings and a 2025 rape arrest, plus older armed-group killings in south. No per-capita rate derivable.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Mayor apologised after 2024 drag assault; human-rights commission investigates but lacks enforcement power without national law.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Violence is documented but unrated as a rate/campaign; police response is mixed, with Pride arrests alongside official apology.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No national SOGI anti-discrimination law; equality bill stalled/rejected. Remedies are patchwork and locality-dependent.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Local ordinances, harassment statutes and commission investigation provide partial recourse; no documented visitor remedy outcomes.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainties include border documents, facilities, hospital placement and whether custody annex practice generalises — unanswered questions, not documented exposures.

anchor_checks.comparison: Higher than 0.35-B: no documented routine passport confiscation, identity-check detention or extortion of visitors. The 2020 Pride arrest and exclusion practices are serious but narrower than systematic visitor stops.

Similar to 0.55-C: severity centres on conditional birth-sex custody/facility exposure and partial, uneven remedies rather than imprisonment for identity. Here custody practice is documented as abusive, but no ward/facility visitor rule is documented.

Lower than 0.65-A: no national equality protection with reliable release/compensation; protection is patchwork, exclusions carry little consequence, and custody safety depends on inmate hierarchies rather than policy.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: no visitor-facing criminalisation or organised targeting, and some local protections and official apologies operate, but there is no national backstop. The harshest documented operative exposure is birth-sex male custody if detained, amplified by patchwork recourse. Street exclusions and scattered violence without a derivable rate sit below organised targeting. Unknown border/facility/care questions are not counted as exposures. This places the case in elevated risk, between routine-detention and working-protection anchors.
